scheme_name: Satyvadi Raja Harishchandra Marnotar Sahay Yojana
other_conditions: The deceased person and the applicant must be native of Gujarat
Both the deceased person and the applicant must belong to Scheduled Castes
The application must be submitted within six months of the death
Only one person in the family of the deceased can receive the benefit
Annual income of the applicant must be more than ₹6,00,000 for both rural and urban areas
benefits_summary: Scheduled caste families receive a financial assistance of ₹5,000 at the time of a family member's death for funeral expenses.
documents_required: Death registration certificate of the deceased person
